channel.title: Daily Market Radio | Your 5-Minute Market Briefing
channel.description:
Every trading day, four short briefings: Wall Street (S&P 500, Nasdaq, Dow, Treasury yields), the Tokyo Stock Exchange, China and Hong Kong, and Europe. Every number is a closing price checked against public sources. Built for your commute.
For educational and informational purposes only. Nothing in this show is investment, financial, legal or tax advice, or a recommendation to buy, sell or hold any security. Written with the help of AI and read by synthetic voices after the numbers are checked. Both hosts are fictional characters. Investing involves risk, including the possible loss of principal.
